notes.title: Version 0.1.2.7 [EA] Now Available
notes.notes:
[h3]Attention Station Commanders!
[/h3][p][b]Version 0.1.2.7 [EA] [/b]is now available on your Steam Client - please restart Steam to auto-update to this version now! [/p]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New building: [b]Quantum Storage Unit[/b]: Feed in items and parts and access them from your Drone's inventory anywhere
[*] New Parts: [b]Quantum Crystals[/b] and [b]Quantum Computers[/b]
[*] New Building: [b]Centrifuge[/b]: Can turn Nuclear Waste into useable Uranium
[*] Added [b]Thai [/b]Language
[*] Added [b]Portuguese (Brazil)[/b] language
[*] Added [b]Turkish [/b]lanaguage
[*] Can now build blueprints onto the top level of your station (hold ALT)
[*] Can now overlap blueprint parts over same-sized buildings
[*] The "Create Blueprint" UI now takes up less screen space
[*] The Mk 2 Smelter now has a 100% output speed increase over the Mk 1
[*] The [b]Module Priority[/b] system has been reworked:
[list]
[*] All building start at Priority 3
[*] Items will be sent to highest priority buildings first and only to lower priority when full
[*] Can now mass-set priorities using the Multi-Select tool
[/list]
[*] Can now choose which Module Mk 1/2/3 you want to build when placing a building, and your choice will be saved for the default in future
[*] Added a Item Input Rate readout on modules
[*] Artifact no longer get stuck between two Artifact Analyzers when dropped exactly between them
[*] Can now set item filters on the Drone Inventory and Quantum Storage
[*] Added Credits in main menu
[*] When in REPAIR Mode all damaged modules are now highlighted
[*] You can now chain buildings with multiple pipe connectors together such as Fusion Reactors
[*] Placing pipes now highlights colliding modules
[*] Added an option to remove screen-shakes and radiation glitch effects
[*] Added a Trash All button to containers so you can quickly destroy items inside/destroy them
[*] Added a keyboard shortcut to sort items in your drone or selected/hovered module
[*] Added a hotkey to open/close the Filter Item menu
[*] Added an icon in the Status View for shielded modules
[*] Identical equipment will now be combined in the HUD to take up less space (e.g. Defence Micro Drone)
[*] Exotic matter asteroids now spawn in Junkyard zone 
[*] Holding ALT now always shows expanded popups in LINK mode
[*] Added option to lock cursor when middle-mouse panning
[*] Made some changes to the Particle Accelerator power consumption compared to loop length
[*] Mk 2 Smelter item send speed increased to 300 items/min
[*] Now much easier to see if you have insufficient amounts of an item
[*] Can now disable "Freighters Waiting" in the Settings > User Interface menu
[*] Multi-selling lots of buildings now only creates a single pod for leftover items you cannot store in your drone
[*] Servitors will always drop off resources into a destination that has space, or will wait with a message if none are available
[*] Full Module Stun upgrade now makes modules impervious to being stunned
[*] Added 2 x Shield Generator to Crusader parts list
[*] You can now hold SHIFT to quickly LINK modules using the Multi-Select mode
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where having 2 x Depot buildings (e.g. Fuel Bay/Ammo Bay) above each other can grab the current ship
[*] Fixed some Cloud miner Collision
[*] Blueprints with radar dishes no longer appear unconnected in space
[*] Pipe directions now saved in Blueprints correctly (new blueprints only)
[*] Freighter Docks and Wormholes in blueprints are now named correctly when built
[*] Modules no longer appear in Low Power state when built from Blueprint
[*] Throwing an explosive Gasbag Plant at another will now explode both plants
[*] Thumb Mouse Button now shows as "Thumb" in inputs
[*] Fixed an issue when building modules with Upper Layer Hidden enabled not being hidden
[*] Newly spawned asteroids now appear in the map view
[*] Fixed an issue where pipes would show as wrong direction in some situations
[*] Fixed an issue with modules appearing in Low Power mode after being built via Blueprints
[*] You can now select "None" in multi-select mode to reset factory recipes
[*] Invalid modules no longer count towards total build cost when placing a blueprint
[*] Connected buildings no longer highlight when using multi-select mode
[*] Fixed an issue where you could leave parts of your station disconnected
[*] The servitor bot now shows the correct target asteroid type etc
[*] Events no longer clips on the map view (e.g. electromagnetic storm)
[*] Artifacts/asteroids out-of-map-bounds now will be fixed on loading game
[*] Calculator can now accept commas as decimal separators
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.2.6 [EA] Now Available
notes.notes:
[h3]Attention Station Commanders!
[/h3][p][b]Version 0.1.2.6 [EA] [/b]is now available on your Steam Client - please restart Steam to auto-update to this version now! [/p]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New [b]Multi-Select[/b] tool: Select up to 50 buildings and make changes to all of them at the same time or create a blueprint from them
[*] New [b]Blueprints [/b]tool: Create a template from multiple buildings to easily duplicate them around your station
[*] Added [b]Multiple Hotbars[/b]: Have up to 5 active hotbars and cycle between them using ALT+Mouse-Wheel
[*] Added a [b]Calculator [/b](Accessed via the toolbar or with the "U" hotkey)
[*] Added [b]Spanish Language[/b]
[*] Set the max input items Shipyards will take from linked modules
[*] Added a Multiplayer Text Chat system (Press ENTER to text chat while in a MP game)
[*] Added a "Travel through wormhole" button to the Wormhole Terminus to teleport to the other side of a selected wormhole
[*] Can now rotate a building when replacing a current building with it using MMB
[*] Railgun Ammo uses more resources to manufacture
[*] Can now drag sliders in the Settings menu
[*] Can no longer assign both primary and alternate key bindings to the same input
[*] Reduced "Ship Reactor Failing" warnings: now will not appear until at a lower level and not in a Fuel Bay being fuelled
[*] Fuel Bays now show stored fuel in hovered popup menu
[*] Can now replace a connector on the top level of a station with a vertical connector
[*] Increased [b]Max Send Rate[/b] on [b]Mk 2 Wormholes[/b] and [b]Mk 3 Storage[/b] and [b]Freighter Docks[/b] to bring them up to the speed of the Mk 3 Miner (with upgrades)
[*] Player Drone will no longer fly towards the cursor if it is over a UI element
[*] When using SORT, items will be placed into slots with filters first
[*] The Servitor Bot Station can no longer be damaged
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Factories use less power when set to a lower Max Efficiency level
[*] Can no longer transfer items to/from freighters when they are far away from your Drone
[*] Client can no longer pause a multiplayer game
[*] Fixed a bug with Mk 2 Wormhole & Mk 3 Freighter Dock not having correct starting name (Alpha/Beta/etc)
[*] Fixed a bug when swapping zones using the bottom-right toolbar can cause a black screen
[*] Linking a Tug-Source-Module (e.g. Fuel Bay) now shows "too far" correctly whether you are linking to another module or a free space
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.2.5 [EA] Now Available
notes.notes:
[h3]Attention Station Commanders!
[/h3][p][b]Version 0.1.2.5 [EA] [/b]is now available on your Steam Client - please restart Steam to auto-update to this version now! [/p]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New [b]Equipment system[/b]: Craft a variety of pieces of equipment in the new Equipment Station that enhances your drone's capabilities - [b]Note: Must be Unlocked with Objective at Station Level 4[/b]
[*] New [b]Tech Upgrades[/b] system: New range of upgrades to your Drone, Equipment and Station (NOTE: This update will reset your current Tech Points)
[*] New building: [b]Mk 2 Wormhole[/b] which has 6 x pipe connectors, more item slots and faster item send rate
[*] New building: [b]Mk 2 Bio-Extractor[/b]
[*] New building: [b]Mk 2 Storage Tank[/b]
[*] You can now [b]build Mk 2 / Mk 3 buildings directly[/b] using the toggle-button to the left of the building items
[*] Wormholes now have larger, easier to read pipe connector markers
[*] Abilities now appear in the bottom-left and have tooltips to show function and hotkey(s)
[*] Warnings can now be toggled on and off in the [b]Settings > User Interface[/b] menu
[*] Radioactive materials now cause damage when stored in containers
[*] Liquid and Gas slots can now be filtered
[*] Pipe Flow rate can now be set directly using an Edit-Box
[*] Added 3 x new Station Colour options: [b]Orange, Purple and Dark-Blue[/b]
[*] Status View icons scale can be changed in the Settings > User Interface menu
[*] Current factory recipe or most-stored-item in storages now shown in Module's minimal popup menu
[*] Wormholes in the popup list now shows the Zone's name next to it
[*] Freighters will no longer visit docks that are switched-off
[*] If a freighter cannot unload at a dock due to filters set, it will not wait even if set to "Infinite" drop-off setting
[*] Miners will show yellow in the Status View if manually set to less than 100% efficiency
[*] Freighter Docks can be placed side-by-side even at Mk 2 and Mk 3
[*] Added a "Connected" filter on the Wormhole Popup List
[*] Added an additional Silica and Carbon Ore resource node to Asteroid Belt #3 Location
[*] You can now Link an Ammo Depot > Ammo Depot and if filtered to a single ammo-type each then tugs will move from one to another correctly
[*] Added "All Asteroids" gather option on Servitor Bot
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed many [b]Servitor-Bot[/b] issues:
[list][*] 2 bots will no longer try to grab the same object / repair the same module / align the same panel
[*] Artifacts will be dropped near the Analyzer if it is already working on an artifact
[*] Gasbag plants will no longer explode if being moved by a Servitor Bot
[*] Fixed several other issues[/list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could show a black screen if changing zone with a building selected
[*] Wormholes will no longer try to take too many resources when full up or filtered
[*] Amount numbers on items no longer go over the bounds of the icons when very large
[*] Fixed an issue with the drone teleporting too often when in ultra-widescreen mode
[*] Zone popups in the System View no longer cut off at the top of the screen
[*] Fixed an issue with the tutorial where completing Basic Manufacturing before the correct tutorial * step locks you out of progressing
[*] CTRL+Clicking items can move into/out of containers correctly
[*] Codex Recipes now take tech upgrades into account when showing time to craft
[/list]

[b]Please Note: Polish and Vietnamese translations for this update are not currently complete - these will be coming very soon![/b]

notes.title: Version 0.1.2.4 [EA] Now Available
notes.notes:
[h3]Attention Station Commanders!
[/h3][p][b]Version 0.1.2.4 \[EA] [/b]is now available on your Steam Client - please restart Steam to auto-update to this version now! [/p]

[h3]Changes:[/h3][p]
• Station Levels now split into multiple smaller, faster-to-complete [b]Objectives [/b]so you can choose what technologies to unlock and later levels feel less "grindy"[/p][p][/p][p][b]Please Note: Because some earlier Station Levels have been condensed in this update, you may end up with a lower station level than before, but you will not lose any progress or unlocks.[/b][/p][p]
• Added [b]German [/b]translation
• Added an Asteroid Belt #3 location at Level 8
• Can now hold ALT when Linking to make/break a reverse link
• Added a button on Module Popup to refresh all link paths
• Mk 1/2/3 now displayed on Find Freighter and Freighter Docks lists
• Added Asteroid Belt #2 and #3 in Codex
• Can now hold shift to add X 10 modules/ships/upgrades/etc to the TODO list
• Fixed some TODO list formatting so size/alignment doesn't change when you add/remove items
• Removed tooltips when Item Filter popup list is open
• Can now link the Antimatter Reactor to Wormholes/Freighter Docks etc
• Cloud Miners no longer use power when the Miner is blocked and idle
• Cloud Miners now provide a more neat and even 50 resources/min (approx.)
• Reduced "Advanced" and "Item filter" panel size by moving titles into tabs
• Can now set Freighter Dock Priority

[/p][h3]Fixes:[/h3][p]
• Tugs now move ships correctly into an area on Client
• Can now hold ALT to see module details when while Linking
• Bio-Extractor popup no longer moves up and down with the machine's animation
• Tug Destination Areas smaller collision to make adding easier
• Creature Swarm creatures can no longer follow you between locations
• Removing required input items from a factory mid-processing now cancels the process
• Fixed an issue with Meteor Strike warning staying onscreen
• Fixed an issue where you couldn't use the Freighter Popup Panel after using the Advanced/Filters panels
• Fixed an issue with Incoming Damage Effect preventing buttons being clicked

[b]Please Note: Parts of the Chinese localisation for this update are currently still under development and may not be 100% accurate. 

We are currently looking for Chinese-language players to help refine and improve the Chinese localisation of the game - if you would like to help with this, please email us at [u]support@trickjumpgames.com[/u] or join our Discord Server - thanks![/b][/p]

notes.title: Version 0.1.2.2 [EA] Now Available
notes.notes:
[h3]Attention Station Commanders!
[/h3]
[b]Version 0.1.2.2 [EA] [/b]is now available on your Steam Client - please restart Steam to auto-update to this version now!
[h3]Changes:
[/h3]
[list]
[b][*] The Status View has had a major rework:[/b][list]
[*] Current Recipe now easier to see on Factories
[*] Current Ship now shown on Shipyards
[*] Most stored item now shown on Storage Units and Freighter Docks
[*] More warnings
[*] Clearer healthbars
[*] Shows how many items are being sent per min
[*] Status View icons now reduce in size at highest zoom levels
[/list]
[b][*] Item Filters:[/b][list]
[*] Now has seperate button for Item Filters
[*] Moved filter menu so it no longer covers any slots
[*] Shows filter when hovering a slot and can use CTRL+C and CTRL+V on hovered slots to copy them
[*] Can now set a filter to the current slot occupied item
[*] Can copy/paste setups in Wormholes
[*] Improved item filter list with item icons
[/list]
[b][*] Freighters:[/b][list]
[*] Mk 3 Freighter Dock and Mk 3 Freighter with more capacity, HP, speed and has a weapons turret mounted on it
[*] Can now assign a dock to be both Pickup and Dropoff location on the same Freighter
[*] Pure Gas/Liquid freighters no longer wait around when full
[*] More controls for how a freighter waits at a drop-off location
[*] Freighter no longer visits pickup locations when full, or drop-off locations when empty
[*] Fixed a bug when selling a freighter and then selecting it
[*] Added an extra pipe connector to Mk 2 and Mk 3 Docks
[*] Fixed a bug with the Freighter Cargo dissapearing
[/list]
[*] Made some optimisations to the factory processing algorithm to improve manufacturing timing,
[*] You can now switch off Storage Units and Storage Tanks to stop all resources being sent to/from them easily
[*] Current Item Output rate now shown on module popups
[*] You now use MMB or N while in Link Mode to add a Stopover and control paths
[*] Can now Reroll Tech Points
[*] Can now Search the lists of Wormholes, Freighter Docks and Power Linkers
[*] List auto-scrolls to first connected/selected Wormhole, Freighter Dock or Power Linker
[*] Ammo Depots now take any ammo from linked factories and modules
[*] Can now link the Antimatter Reactor to Refinery directly
[*] Animation Optimsations are now less aggressive
[*] Can now wipe all links (inc. input links) using CTRL+X
[*] Can now set Max Efficiency for Shipyards, Miners and Cloud Miners
[*] Particle Accelerators now give slight bonus efficiency the longer the loop is
[*] Particle Accelerators now show output items/min
[*] Objectives items can be counted from any HUB
[*] You can now Duplicate Pipes and Conduits
[*] Carbon Nanotubes and Nuclear Waste now have max stack size of 500
[*] You now see a warning when station is using your stored power
[*] Mk 2 Smelter is faster
[*] Mk 2 Fuel Bay now has 2000 Capacity
[*] Added the fuelling rate on Fuel Bays
[*] Can now manually move items into a lot even if it is filtered
[*] Animation Level Of Detail now scales with the Settings > View Distance setting
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a "max objects" error when you fly around placing a building for an extended period of time
[*] Fixed black-screen issue when teleporting to the HUB and then switching Zone
[*] Antimatter Reactor can now be restarted correctly after being full of waste
[*] If you start repairing a module, moving the mouse will not hover over another modules mid-repair
[*] Doors in connectors graphics now have 2 sides
[*] Doors in connectors now have a max visible distance
[*] Radiation effect and damage screen shake no longer shows on Map View
[*] Larger UI Scales no longer cut off the top of the Shipyard UI popup
[*] Drone no longer follows cursor when mouse is offscreen
[*] Fog Of War bubble no longer appears in multiplayer when other player is in another Zone
[*] Tugs no longer drop off ships to switched-off fuel or ammo bays
[*] Shows Mk 2 on Build Display when duplicating an upgraded module
[*] Fixed a bug with selling a ship that a tug is currently carrying blocking that tug's operation
[/list]
[b]...See you in the TAU System commanders![/b]

notes.title: Version 0.1.2.1 [EA] Now Available
notes.notes:
[h3]Attention Station Commanders!
[/h3]
[b]Version 0.1.2.1 [EA] [/b]is now available on your Steam Client - please restart Steam to auto-update to this version now!
[h3]Changes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Major performance optimisations
[*] Optimised selling and mass-selling on very large stations
[*] Tug system has been reworked:
[list]
[*] Tugs will not try and move multiple ships into the same destination
[*] Tugs now have a larger range of operations
[*] Tugs will move ships into the Fuel Bay with the most fuel stored (if possible)
[*] If you link Shipyard > Fuel Bay > Ammo Depot > Location then tugs will auto-move a ship that doesnt need ammo to the end location after fuelling is complete
[*] You can now grab a ship from a tub to override it
[*] Tugs will now drop the current ship and return to base if you switch off its parent Tug Bay
[/list]
[*] Wormholes now act as Containment Chambers
[*] Stack Size of Nuclear Waste increased to 500
[*] Wormholes can now be linked directly to Antimatter Reactors
[*] Antimatter Reactor power output is now 5000 MW
[*] Optional objectives will now warn you if there is no space for multiple rewards in Hub
[*] You can now set defaults for Max Factory Outputs
[*] If you complete an Optional Objective without enough space in your Hub, rewards will now be spawned inside an escape pod above the hub
[*] You can no longer build a Fuel Bay or Ammo Depot directly above a Shipyard or other Fuel Bay/Ammo Depot
[*] Neutron Initiators now use a lot more Uranium but a lot less SuperAlloy
[*] Exotic Matter now appears in the Filter List
[*] When you Upgrade a module, the last slot's filter settings will be copied into the new slots
[*] You can now set a module's efficiency using an Edit Box
[*] Added a small timeout delay on Wormhole UI to reduce chance of mis-click
[*] Altered Fusion Reactor collision slightly to let 2 be placed across from each other
[*] Larger ships which more max fuel now have longer Meltdown times
[*] Improved the Pipe-Flow algorithm when FPS is lower
[*] You can now rebind Pause Game and Codex
[*] Can now move and store Neutron Initiators in the Containment Chamber
[*] Major optimisations on completed ships sitting around your station
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would crash with "max objects exceeded" error
[*] Ambient sound-settings now saved between sessions
[*] Fixed an issue where user would hear loud noise on startup
[*] Music no longer stops when player is killed
[*] Fixed an issue where carried objects would shoot offscreen after game is paused while dragging them
[*] Fixed an issue where the Power Linker would not re-initialise after being damaged and auto-repaired
[*] Fixed an issue where turret range turns white during an ice-storm event
[*] When loading a game, modules that are switched off now appear correctly
[*] Fixed an issue with Duplicating a module and dragging out connectors and causing some links to be lost
[*] Status View icons no longer dissappear after Hiding Upper Level
[*] Module's label changes now appear while Status View is active
[*] Fixed a bug with using Escape etc after using the Choose Item Amount popup
[*] Ship fusion-reactor meltdown timers are now saved and loaded correctly
[*] If you duplicate a factory it will now use overridden max input/output/power settings correctly even if you changed the defaults
[*] Save-files now show local time correctly
[/list]
[b]...See you in the TAU System commanders![/b]

notes.title: Version 0.1.2.0 [EA] Now Available
notes.notes:
[h3]Attention Station Commanders!
[/h3]
[b]Version 0.1.2.0 [EA] [/b]is now available on your Steam Client - please restart Steam to auto-update to this version now!

[h3]Changes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mk 3 Miner upgrade (unlocks at Level 10)
[*] Mk 3 Storage upgrade (unlocks at Level 9)
[*] You can now rebind WASD/Arrow keys for moving camera and drone
[*] You can now rebind all Hotbar 1-10 keys
[*] You can now set a Max Output amount for all factories
[*] In Advanced Mode you can now use CTRL+C to copy a Slot's settings and CTRL+V to paste it into another slot
[*] Increased pipe flow-rate to 300/min
[*] Several performance optimisations
[*] Cloud Miners now show how much hydrogen they produce/min
[*] You can now Build and Sell while the game is paused
[*] Added game option to enable/disable Environmental Hazards (e.g. Gas Clouds)
[*] Added warnings if a power generator is low on fuel (less than a minute left) or its output is full of waste
[*] Tweaked solar panel efficiency algorithm
[*] In Advanced Mode if you select a slot that has a filter, popup will default to that filter
[*] Cloud Miner warnings no longer show the Popup
[*] Now shows hotkeys for adding build items to the Hotbar
[*] Small Fuel Tanks recipe now uses less Nano-Plate
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some path-finding issues to make nicer paths
[*] Optimised Mass-Selling lots of modules
[*] Now displays game time correctly when over 24-hours in-game time
[*] Clicking off a label in Advanced Mode now confirms the change in text
[*] Improved how tugs function
[*] Photon Tanker Icon now correct
[*] Smelter/Storage now sends to Containment Chamber correctly
[*] If you sell a tug its warning message are now removed
[*] Multiple nearby Atomizers no longer "fight" over nearby resources
[*] Fixed an issue with swapping zones while building pipes
[*] Tooltip now says "add to todo list" on hotbar items
[*] When upgrading a Freighter with item filters, no longer sets the gas slot to the filter incorrectly
[*] Can now rebind Q & E correctly
[*] Secondary hotkeys now save correctly
[*] Can see the Save-Game name even at higher UI scales
[*] Station View now shows icons on newly built modules
[*] Placing Modules no longer collide with objects (e.g. asteroids) in-game
[*] You no longer lose items when replacing a Mk 2 Storage with a Mk 1 Storage
[*] Fixed an issue with tugs bouncing up and down on pads
[*] Module Priority indicator now appears after save & load correctly
[/list]
...See you in the TAU System commanders!

notes.title: Version 0.1.1.9 [EA] now available
notes.notes:

[/b]
[b]Changes:
[/b][list]

[*] New Solar Panel system - solar panels now only need to be aligned once when built, but will be a little less efficient the more you have connected on the same power network
[*] Advanced Plate recipe now uses less SuperAlloy
[*] Atomizing Gas Giant creatures now yields Nitratium

[*] You can no longer keep synthesizing if your inventory is full or you do not have the required items
